prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily forward through a long tunnel of red torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan, under a cloudy and foggy night sky. The camera advances along a paved path flanked by rows of identical vermilion torii gates, their vibrant color standing out against the dimly lit surroundings. As the viewer progresses, the mist thickens, creating an ethereal atmosphere that obscures distant details. The camera angle remains level, providing a clear view of the path ahead, which gradually narrows into the distance. The ambient lighting is minimal, with soft glows emanating from lanterns hanging between some of the torii gates, casting a warm, reddish hue over the scene. The environment is devoid of people, enhancing the sense of solitude. Midway through the journey, the camera turns slightly to the right, revealing a small building with illuminated windows and a set of stairs leading up to another torii gate. The camera continues its forward motion, passing through more torii gates until it reaches an open area where the path splits. The final segment shows the camera turning left, entering another tunnel of torii gates, maintaining the same steady pace and level angle, enveloped by the serene and mysterious ambiance of the shrine at night.
